component.name: Path of Upgrading
component.summary: Check Path of Exile 2 items against your build

description.p: Path of Upgrading tells you whether an item in Path of Exile 2 is an upgrade for your build. Press a hotkey over an item in the game and a popup shows how it compares with what you wear.

ul.li: Rates items by a gear score, by your own stat weights, or by Path of Building once you have imported a build
Imports builds from Path of Building, including the Flatpak, from a code, a link or a file
Searches the trade site for upgrades or similar items, in your league, including hardcore
Prices an item and finds bases to craft on

description.p: The popup is drawn over the game, so it needs a desktop with layer shell support, such as KDE Plasma on Wayland. Path of Building for Path of Exile 2 has to be installed to import builds.
